methods: Population figures are census counts from the Statistics Bureau of Japan; 2025 is the preliminary count of the 2025 Population Census.
GDP figures are nominal unless marked PPP; dollar GDP moves with the yen, so the 2020–2024 fall is mostly the weaker yen, not a smaller economy in yen terms.
Unemployment and CPI figures are annual averages of the Labour Force Survey and the Consumer Price Index.
Age-structure shares for 2025 are from the 2025 Population Census and may not sum to exactly 100% after rounding.

sources.covers: Population Census 2000–2025; Labour Force Survey; Consumer Price Index
